description: A handful of rows have impossible ages (e.g. 150, -5, 999) -- data entry / sensor errors that a quick .describe() or histogram on 'age' reveals immediately.
hints: Try df.describe() and look at each column's min and max -- one of them should not be physically possible.
Focus on the 'age' column specifically. What's the maximum value? What's the minimum?
Some rows have age = 150, 200, 999 or even -5. Those are the planted fault.
